messages.content:
Plan from the robot's forward-facing camera: image left/right are robot left/right; centered is straight ahead. Translation steps are 0.25 m; turns are 30 degrees in place. Later actions use the heading after earlier turns. Return the complete ordered plan using at most 4 actions, as few as needed. Outside the thought channel, output only tool calls. This is an unexecuted mock plan.
Use brief, efficient reasoning. Avoid repetition and unnecessary elaboration.

content.text: Face the fridge and take one step toward it. What tool calls would you run?

function.name: move
function.description: Translate one step; left/right strafe without turning.

function.name: turn
function.description: Rotate in place toward the given side.
